sections.name: A third try at the tester's greeting round? The tester, not the game: it reaches Ron but runs out of day before Darren and Sheila, because the office now costs it time. It would greet them two mornings on, when all three are close together till 13:00. A small change to the tester only.
sections.recommendation: Yes. Under ten minutes and no change to the game; without it tonight's walk and Monday's exit show two failed stages that are the tester's lateness, explained but not cleared. No web link: the answer is this page.
